findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts:117,175-214,262-263 [high] review_run_start independently assembles and persists a review-run Prompt Envelope after the reviewer is already running, but returns only the run/envelope IDs and never delivers assembly.prompt. Its signed ReviewRun.promptHash remains optional caller-controlled input and is only folded into launcherSpecDigest, not required to equal the envelope assembledPromptDigest. agent_prompt can emit only a story-dispatch audit Envelope, so no trusted path proves that the review-run Envelope was the Prompt actually received by the reviewer. A pass can therefore satisfy the new gate while binding a canonical prompt that was never model input, violating the decision contract that the same process that sends the Prompt must calculate/record it. Integrate reviewer dispatch with review-run assembly or otherwise mechanically bind and deliver the exact assembled bytes before accepting pass evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b4efda425c: review_run_start now returns and signs the exact canonical assembled Prompt, removes caller-supplied prompt/promptHash, and focused review-run smoke verifies delivered bytes equal assembledPromptDigest.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts:82-186 and packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:489-518 — [HIGH] The gate-consumed Prompt Envelope verifier proves only that envelopeId hashes the envelope fields; it never proves roleId equals reviewer lane, rolePrompt matches the registered role render, or the Runtime/Role digests match the actual prompt bytes. assembleFullPromptEnvelope accepts an arbitrary rolePrompt and a roleContract for lattice-review-concept while lane=lattice-review-quality, verifyPromptEnvelopeIntegrity returns true, and a ReviewRun signed over that envelopeId is accepted by verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope. Repro: build, then assemble a review-run envelope with roleContract concept, rolePrompt ATTACKER-CONTROLLED PROMPT, lane quality; signReviewRun with the returned envelopeId; both verifyReviewRun and verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope return true. This violates CHK-001 envelope-role-contract-coherence and CHK-003 gate-path shared verification, so a structurally valid but semantically wrong reviewer prompt can become gate evidence. Derive the prompt/contract from the canonical lane inside the trusted assembler or persist enough canonical material to recompute it, enforce roleId===lane for review-run envelopes, and add a gate-path regression test for prompt/role/lane substitution.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b4efda425c: trusted assembly derives and verifies canonical lane/role contract/render coherence; roleId must equal reviewer lane and cross-role/prompt substitution fails closed in envelope and review-run smokes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts:48-76 [high] FullTaskContext reduces each checklist item to id/title/status/context/userSees and carries only a scope digest. It omits verificationIntent, candidate source/test files, relatedDocs and the bounded candidate/scope facts that the execution plan defines as Full Context. Consequently the assembled review-run prompt cannot expose the acceptance criteria or review surface it claims to bind; the smoke test at packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-full-context-envelope-smoke.ts:29-42 only exercises the same minimal shape and cannot detect the omission. Include the canonical bounded verification intents and candidate file/document/scope context (or an equivalently complete, mechanically resolvable trusted representation) in TaskContext and its digest before calling this full context.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b4efda425c: FullTaskContext now includes canonical verificationIntent, candidate source/test files, relatedDocs and bounded scope facts, all digest-bound and covered by full-context smoke.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts:88-165 does not validate roleContract.renderDigest against the supplied rolePrompt (or otherwise enforce canonical Role Contract/render coherence). Verified repro against built code: assembleFullPromptEnvelope accepted lattice-review-quality RoleContract combined with the lattice-review-behavior prompt, emitted roleId=lattice-review-quality, verifyPromptEnvelopeIntegrity=true, and the assembled prompt ended with the behavior prompt. This violates must intent envelope-role-contract-coherence and lets a miswired trusted caller sign an internally valid ReviewRun envelope for the wrong role instructions. Add a fail-closed coherence check and a cross-role mutation test.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b4efda425c: roleContract renderDigest is checked against the canonical role Prompt and cross-role mutation is rejected; regression test proves prior repro fails closed.

findings.desc: Gate-consumer coverage is materially incomplete for 7 must intents. packages/main/src/tasks/review-run-smoke.ts only calls verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope directly; packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-full-context-envelope-smoke.ts only checks isReviewerAgent/resolveReviewRunLane directly. The submitted suite contains no full-envelope or compatibility/retired-role scenario in review-assurance-floor-smoke.ts, quorum-submit-smoke.ts, or flow-stability-smoke.ts (source search finds none). Therefore REVIEW transition/current receipt, assurance floor and quorum are not exercised with tampered/replayed envelopes or numerically sufficient compatibility-only evidence, and removing one consumer filter would not be caught. This fails review-gates-consume-envelope-proof, replay-new-head/round/run, gate-paths-share-envelope-verifier, compatibility-only-review/assurance/quorum-blocked, all-gate-consumers-share-role-filter and rollback-never-downgrades-gates. Add focused end-to-end/mutation-sensitive fixtures through each real consumer, not registry-string assertions.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b4efda425c: machine REVIEW, review-assurance-floor and quorum real-consumer tests now cover envelope replay/tamper plus compatibility/retired-only evidence and mutation-sensitive shared filtering; all focused suites pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.ts:458-479 does not test the must intent compatibility-only-assurance-floor-blocked. The fixture includes a valid canonical host verdict and asserts report.ok=true; compatibility/retired rows are only injected as findings, so the test proves they do not raise failureSignals, not that compatibility-only review evidence cannot satisfy the assurance floor. Production evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor consumes findings plus host-verdict process events and never reads ReviewRun/ReviewPass/PromptEnvelope, while process-fact-levels.ts still declares Prompt Envelope and role eligibility as direct assurance-floor gate consumers. Either make the floor consume and verify structured eligible reviewer/envelope provenance, or narrow the declared contract/intent to the actual indirect quorum boundary and add a test that fails if that boundary is bypassed. The current passing test cannot validate the promised gate fact.

B-dd81 verification evidence is not fully fresh: checklist CHK-002 contains two rows for intent agent-prompt-story-full-assembly. The current row is bound to b4efda425c/storyFilesHash 82d096aa, but the older duplicate integration_test row remains bound to 75f937812b/storyFilesHash 1b35eb0a. session_brief reports exactly 1 stale verification intent after the round-2 refresh. Remove or replace the obsolete duplicate through the checklist evidence command path and confirm slim/full coverage reports 47 intent refs with no stale rows before TEST.

packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts:173-184 and packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:528-542 [HIGH] review-run creation and gate verification both read the package-owned raw template, so they are mutually self-consistent even when the prompt actually rendered/loaded for the reviewer host differs. The standard reviewer launch is separately built by packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:294-331 and Codex loads .lattice-codex/agents/lattice-review-quality.md; neither byte stream/digest is bound into the saved Envelope or checked by the gate. Confirmed on the current worktree after build: package/renderedForCodex SHA-256=f7ec0664... while the actual Codex asset SHA-256=fe57b551... (renderedEqualsActualAsset=false), yet the focused Envelope/ReviewRun/quorum smokes pass because both producer and verifier reread the same package template. Thus a stale or altered host role prompt can mint a pass accepted under an Envelope for different role instructions, and the round-2 fix does not establish mutual consistency among dispatch lane, rendered role prompt, saved Envelope, and returned assembled prompt. Bind the actual host-rendered dispatch input (or a mechanically verified asset/render identity plus dispatch wrapper) before launch, persist its digest/bytes, and make gate verification reject host-render or dispatch drift; add a mutation test that changes the host-rendered asset/dispatch prompt while leaving the package template unchanged.
